rationale: An AI agent holds no authority and MUST stop on an unresolved authority conflict rather than silently choosing a policy.
stopConditions: A task requires implementation code but no implementation directive exists.
title: Required stop condition for unresolved authority conflict
description: Baseline valid ai-governance artefact with a canonical aiKind, authorityOrderAcknowledged true, non-empty stopConditions, and treatedAsAuthoritative false.
aiGuidance: Obey these stop conditions; do not treat AI output as authoritative without validation, and stop on unresolved authority conflict.
